q: At what age is bone density highest?
By how much does density increase from age 10 to 20?
Describe the pattern across a lifetime.
Density rises quickly in adolescence, peaks at about 20 to 30, then falls slowly, faster after 50.
Use the data to explain why exercise and calcium matter most for teenagers.
Most bone is built between 10 and 20; a higher peak means density stays above the danger level for longer as it falls in old age, lowering the risk of fractures (osteoporosis).
